title: Rename Data Parade posts to articles: dataparade.io/articles, /posts redirects
description:
Ryan (2026-10-30): the DataParade client wants "articles", not "posts". Move the article pages from dataparade.io/posts to dataparade.io/articles on both sites, and ship the landing side through DataParade's new CI/CD pipeline (Ryan chose: add a landing deploy workflow).

Order, so nothing breaks in between:
1. dataparade.io CloudFront (domain-edge, account 688128002352): add /articles and /articles/* behaviors to the Papyrus edge, keeping /posts*. By reviewed change set by hand: the pipeline's roles do not cover domain-edge.
2. AnthusAI/DataParade-newsroom: urls.basePath /articles, a pattern redirect ^/posts/(.*)$ -> /articles/$1 (301), labels Posts -> Articles, tests, docs.
3. DataParade-io/dataparade: fold the rename into PR #85 (landing nav, footer, home-page feed at /articles/_data/latest.json, next.config redirects, domain-edge template), merge main into it, add a plan/apply landing deploy workflow modeled on deploy-prod.yml, merge, then plan and apply through the pipeline. Note: production landing runs the #85 branch, 226 commits behind main, so the first pipeline deploy also ships main's landing changes.
Done when dataparade.io/articles/ serves the articles, every old /posts/... URL 301s to /articles/..., the landing home page shows the latest articles, and the landing was deployed by the new workflow.
